properties.name: decorator
properties.description: Draws one or more decorators behind the element's content: images, tiles, gradients, shaders or text. Takes a comma-separated list of decorator functions or @decorator names, each optionally followed by a paint area (border-box, padding-box or content-box).

values.name: image()
values.description: A single image or sprite, with optional flip and fit.

values.name: tiled-horizontal()
values.description: Left, centre and right images; the centre repeats horizontally.

values.name: tiled-vertical()
values.description: Top, centre and bottom images; the centre repeats vertically.

values.name: tiled-box()
values.description: Nine images: four corners, four edges and a centre.

values.name: ninepatch()
values.description: One image split into nine parts by an inner rectangle.

values.name: horizontal-gradient()
values.description: Straight gradient between two colours, left to right.

values.name: vertical-gradient()
values.description: Straight gradient between two colours, top to bottom.

values.name: shader()
values.description: Passes a value to the application's render interface to draw a custom shader.

values.name: text()
values.description: Draws a string of text.

properties.name: font-effect
properties.description: Applies one or more effects to the element's text. Inherited.

values.name: glow()
values.description: glow(<width-outline> <width-blur> [<offset-x> <offset-y>] <color>)

values.name: outline()
values.description: outline(<width> <color>)

values.name: shadow()
values.description: shadow(<offset-x> <offset-y> <color>)

values.name: blur()
values.description: blur(<width> <color>)

properties.name: image-color
properties.description: Colour multiplied into the images the element draws. Defaults to white, which leaves images unchanged.

properties.name: fill-image
properties.description: <progress> only: the image or sprite drawn for the filled part of the bar.

properties.name: nav
properties.description: Shorthand for nav-up, nav-right, nav-down and nav-left, in that order.

properties.name: nav-up
properties.description: Where focus goes when navigating up with the arrow keys or a gamepad: a keyword, or an element id such as #start.

values.name: auto
values.description: The nearest focusable element in that direction.

properties.name: nav-right
properties.description: Where focus goes when navigating right with the arrow keys or a gamepad: a keyword, or an element id such as #start.

values.name: auto
values.description: The nearest focusable element in that direction.

properties.name: nav-down
properties.description: Where focus goes when navigating down with the arrow keys or a gamepad: a keyword, or an element id such as #start.

values.name: auto
values.description: The nearest focusable element in that direction.

properties.name: nav-left
properties.description: Where focus goes when navigating left with the arrow keys or a gamepad: a keyword, or an element id such as #start.

values.name: auto
values.description: The nearest focusable element in that direction.

properties.name: tab-index
properties.description: Whether the element is in the tab order. auto makes it focusable with Tab.

properties.name: focus
properties.description: Whether the element can receive focus. none prevents it. Inherited.

properties.name: drag
properties.description: How the element responds to being dragged.

values.name: drag
values.description: Sends drag events to the element.

values.name: drag-drop
values.description: Sends drag events, and drop events to the element it's released over.

values.name: block
values.description: Stops the drag from reaching ancestors.

values.name: clone
values.description: Drags a copy of the element.

properties.name: scrollbar-margin
properties.description: Shortens the element's scrollbars by this length, usually to leave room where the vertical and horizontal scrollbars meet.

atDirectives.name: @spritesheet
atDirectives.description: Declares a sprite sheet. Set src to the image, then list each sprite as name: x y width height. Sprite names can be used wherever an image is accepted.

atDirectives.name: @decorator
atDirectives.description: Declares a named decorator: @decorator name : type { properties }. Use the name in a decorator property.
